meta.title: ACC & Associates — Construction consulting for projects that have started to drift
meta.description: Independent construction consulting: feasibility, programme and delay analysis, contract administration, superintendent services, defect reporting, expert witness. Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane.

headline: When a project starts
to drift, we're the
reference point it
comes back to.
hero.lede: ACC & Associates is the firm developers and principal contractors call when a project is over budget, behind programme, or heading for a dispute. Independent. Australian. Since 2011.

services_intro: Six services. All independent, all fixed-fee where the scope allows.

steps.title: Brief
steps.detail: 30-minute call, no charge. Tell us the project, the contract, and what has moved.

steps.title: Scope and fixed fee
steps.detail: A one-page scope with named deliverables, a fee, and a date. Signed both ways.

steps.title: Site and documents
steps.detail: Site walk where relevant. Full documents review — programme, contract, RFIs, variations, correspondence.

steps.title: Report or engagement
steps.detail: A written report you can hand to a bank, a builder, or a court. Or an ongoing contract-admin or superintendent role.
